title: The $L^1$-realization of an elliptic operator with unbounded coefficients
summary: We establish an $L^1$-theory for a class of elliptic operators with unbounded coefficients, extending our earlier semigroup generation results and those of Canale--Rhandi--Tacelli to the endpoint $p=1$. The $L^1$-realization generates a positive analytic $C_0$-semigroup that is compact for every positive time. We characterize the generator domain through weighted estimates and prove consistency with the corresponding $L^p$-semigroups for $1<p<\infty$.
